mechanism_claims.claim_text: YD1 directly binds E. coli plasmid DNA in a dose-dependent gel-mobility assay; migration is strongly reduced at 40 μg/mL and absent at greater than 80 μg/mL.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: YD1 against E. coli plasmid DNA
direct_assay_types: plasmid DNA gel mobility shift assay
mechanism_claims.limitations: Direct for DNA affinity; downstream lethal target remains bounded to paper evidence.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TEM and spheroplast/whole-cell assays support intracellular alteration without gross membrane lysis as the dominant mechanism context for YD1-treated E. coli.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=22:Effects of YD1 in Synergism and E. coli cell; xml:fig=5:panels=a-b

mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper reports morphology and intact-spheroplast evidence; it does not fully resolve the entry channel.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Checkerboard/time-kill evidence shows strongest interaction with erythromycin, supporting a macromolecular-synthesis mechanism hypothesis rather than a wall-lysis-only explanation.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: YD1 plus erythromycin in E. coli and MRSA B15
mechanism_claims.limitations: Synergy is contextual support; it is not itself target identification.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: I-TASSER/COACH predicts a nucleic-acid ligand-binding site for YD1; this is computational support consistent with, but weaker than, the DNA-binding assay.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=23:Amino acid sequencing and computational analysis; xml:fig=6:panel=b

mechanism_claims.limitations: Computational prediction only; not curated as direct mechanism without the Fig. 5 DNA-binding assay.
